title: ElevenLabs Agent Tools Explained: Client, Webhook, Code, MCP
desc:
Tools let an ElevenLabs agent act, not just talk. This episode maps the five tool types in ElevenAgents: client, webhook, code, MCP and system tools, and when to pick each. It walks through the documented logMessage client tool and how to register it in code, a code tool that converts temperatures, the ctx object and sandbox limits, connecting an MCP server with the right approval mode, and the naming and model choices that make tool calls reliable.

This episode is a documented walkthrough built from the official ElevenLabs documentation (links below). It does not include a live product recording.
